name: uberasm-reduce-score-to
title: Reduce Score to 0 on a Specific Level
description:
This is a patch that forces the score to 0 at a specific level (which you can specify yourself), but restores it once you enter the other levels.

It uses some free RAM, be sure to read the ReadMe and the comments in the asm.

Request from Knight of Time.

P.S.
Optimized asm. This fixes a bug where scores were not being restored in sublevels.
